hints.title: Last In Record Maintenance
hints.text: Operations reference recent valid scores: C invalidates the last score, D doubles the last score, and plus sums the previous two scores.

hints.title: Sequential Score Record Invariant
hints.text: A dynamic list where items can be appended or removed from the end mirrors operations directly.

hints.title: Linear Operation Simulation Procedure
hints.text: Initialize an empty scores list. For each operation token, if plus, append sum of last two scores; if D, append double of last score; if C, remove last score; otherwise convert token to integer and append. Return sum of all remaining scores in the list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining separate index variables without an append/pop list complicates backtracking on multiple consecutive C operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating with a list processes each token in O(1) amortized time, taking O(N) total time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should map each operation token (+, D, C, integer) to its list operation cleanly.
